title: 608 bearing pillow block
prompt: Model a pillow-block holder for a standard 608 bearing (22 mm OD x 8 mm bore x 7 mm wide): a press-fit bore sized slightly undersize for a light interference fit, a seat at least 8 mm wide (along the bearing axis) to fully support the bearing's 7 mm width, and a flat mounting base with two M5 clearance holes. Drive the bore diameter from a BearingOD parameter (nominal 22 mm, modeled undersized for a press fit) and the mounting-hole diameter from a BoltDia parameter (5.5 mm) via a Parameters spreadsheet.

dimensions.name: bore_diameter
dimensions.comment: Reads the BORE, not the bearing. This check used to read 'BearingOD' and demand it be under 21.95 — but BearingOD is the bearing's own nominal 22 mm by definition, so a correct model failed it every single time. Three runs were blamed on the agent for a defect that was in this file.

dimensions.name: seat_width
dimensions.comment: task says 'at least 8 mm'; wider is not a defect

functional.comment: Pose is pinned by the task (flat mounting base, printed z-up). The 22 mm bearing bore is deliberately NOT perpendicular to the base, so max_hole_dia_mm selects the M5 mounting holes only.
